All powerfists in the army represent chainfists (pre-approved by TO)

Army rule:
Doctrines - apply army wide in command phase, or handed out to individual units by Calgar and Gman in movement phase.
Assault (twice per game): Advance and charge, and deathwatch terminators gain precision within 9"
Devastator (once per game): Gain assault on all weapons, and deathwatch terminators gain sustained hits
Tactical (once per game): Fall back and activate, and deathwatch terminators gain lethal hits

Note that Calgar's unit is eligible for all terminator effects because he himself has the keyword

Detachment rules:
+1 to charge for terminator units
One extra assault doctrine (already accounted for above)
Permission to take 500 points of deathwatch, and the extra deathwatch effects listed above

Strats:
For deathwatch only, all strats here limited to shooting phase:
* Ignore cover and reroll 1s to wound
* +1 strength and +6" range
* Gain anti-non-vehicle 4+

For all terminators:
* 2 CP to -1 damage for one activation
* Gain lethal sustain (available both in shooting and fight phase)
* End of opponent's turn, return a terminator unit to reserve (available in two places, so I can lift two units for a CP each)

For anyone:
* Fight on death on a 4+ (3+ if in assault doctrine)
* Lance (plus an additional AP if in assault doctrine)
* AoC

Notable units:
Deathwatch terminators shoot really hard at 9 attacks and 3x blast with 10/3/3, often with lethals and/or sustains. They reroll charges from their datasheet, and force a battleshock after connecting. Melee is 15 attacks at 3+ 12/2/3 VS monsters/vehicles, 10 attacks 4+ 8/2/2 otherwise.

Gman: Extra CP start of round (not turn), aura of rerolling all 1s, lone op when close to infantry, hand out doctrine *in addition* to what they already have, enabling a unit to be in two doctrines at the same time. Always in all doctrines himself.

Calgar: 44 wounds spread across 6 different defensive profiles, three of which have a 4++, and eligible for terminator buffs, including the -1 damage. Hands out a doctrine. Always in all doctrines.

Impulsors: 5++. Can be granted scout 6 by staring incursors inside, moves 12 itself with possible advance and shoot, and can carry eradicators that get to use its firing deck. Outside melta range, they get 4 attacks at 2+ 12/3/D3+2 against monsters and vehicles, inside melta range half the attacks go to D3+4 and the other half to D3+5. Additionally brings up to 14 (depending on range) anti infantry shots at 4 or 5/1/1.

Army rule:
Doctrines - apply army wide in command phase, or handed out to individual units by Calgar and Gman in movement phase.
Assault (twice per game): Advance and charge, and deathwatch terminators gain precision within 9"
Devastator (once per game): Gain assault on all weapons, and deathwatch terminators gain sustained hits
Tactical (once per game): Fall back and activate, and deathwatch terminators gain lethal hits

Note that Calgar's unit is eligible for all terminator effects because he himself has the keyword

Detachment rules:
+1 to charge for terminator units
One extra assault doctrine (already accounted for above)
Permission to take 500 points of deathwatch, and the extra deathwatch effects listed above

Strats:
For deathwatch only, all strats here limited to shooting phase:
* Ignore cover and reroll 1s to wound
* +1 strength and +6" range
* Gain anti-non-vehicle 4+

For all terminators:
* 2 CP to -1 damage for one activation
* Gain lethal sustain (available both in shooting and fight phase)
* End of opponent's turn, return a terminator unit to reserve (available in two places, so I can lift two units for a CP each)

For anyone:
* Fight on death on a 4+ (3+ if in assault doctrine)
* Lance (plus an additional AP if in assault doctrine)
* AoC

Notable units:
Deathwatch terminators shoot really hard at 9 attacks and 3x blast with 10/3/3, often with lethals and/or sustains. They reroll charges from their datasheet, and force a battleshock after connecting. Melee is 15 attacks at 3+ 12/2/3 VS monsters/vehicles, 10 attacks 4+ 8/2/2 otherwise.

Gman: Extra CP start of round (not turn), aura of rerolling all 1s, lone op when close to infantry, hand out doctrine *in addition* to what they already have, enabling a unit to be in two doctrines at the same time. Always in all doctrines himself.

Calgar: 44 wounds spread across 6 different defensive profiles, three of which have a 4++, and eligible for terminator buffs, including the -1 damage. Hands out a doctrine. Always in all doctrines.

Impulsors: 5++. Can be granted scout 6 by staring incursors inside, moves 12 itself with possible advance and shoot, and can carry eradicators that get to use its firing deck. Outside melta range, they get 4 attacks at 2+ 12/3/D3+2 against monsters and vehicles, inside melta range half the attacks go to D3+4 and the other half to D3+5. Additionally brings up to 14 (depending on range) anti infantry shots at 4 or 5/1/1.
